name: Tara gum
aliases: E417, tara gum, tara seed gum, tara galactomannan, Peruvian carob, Caesalpinia spinosa gum, goma tara, gomme tara
what_is: A galactomannan gum obtained from the endosperm of tara seeds and used mainly as a thickener and stabiliser.
why_botia: Tara gum is obtained from the seeds of a tree that grows mainly in Peru. It thickens by retaining water and is often used with other gums because together they strengthen their ability to form gels. It is not absorbed intact: it reaches the large intestine and may be fermented there. JECFA did not see a need to set a numerical limit.
